annotation.equivalence_rationale: All three responses use the same prioritisation logic: assess urgency, launch impact, and staffing/dependency concerns; put the equipment check ahead of the routine report if it is blocking the launch; treat the report as the most flexible item; and reconsider priorities when equipment status or staffing coverage becomes clearer. The wording differs, but no material addition, omission, or contradiction changes the criterion-level evidence or operational commitments.
